tool: Android dumpsys meminfo -d, invoked over USB ADB 37.0.1
method: One force-stop/cold launch before Explore, followed by sequential foreground UI states without restarting the app or forcing GC. Each sample captures both same-package/same-UID processes, the ActivityManager-managed main activity and its detached companion. Combined PSS is the sum of their reported TOTAL PSS; RSS is reported for the main process only. The companion role was not independently identified.
units: Raw Android kB interpreted as KiB; /1024 gives MiB. PSS apportions shared pages; do not add main RSS, graphics rows, or swap PSS to combined PSS.
limitations: One phone, one sequential session, five snapshots per state; not a continuous startup/route-calculation peak or leak endurance test.
Android shared-page accounting, graphics accounting, caches and OS activity can vary between samples and devices.
The initial 2D-directory sample window overlapped read-only installed-APK hash verification; file-cache effects are possible.
The measured route is a short same-floor route; cross-floor and campus routing were not sampled.
